en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.2027 - It is narrated from Al-Ala from Muhammad ibn Muslim, who narrated from one of the two (Imam Al-Baqir (as) or Imam Al-Sadiq (as), peace be upon them), who said:
"I asked him about the sign of Laylatul Qadr, and Imam (as) replied:
'Its sign is that its breeze is pleasant; if it is in cold weather, it becomes warm, and if it is in hot weather, it becomes cool and pleasant.'"
